claims.statement: For every finite ordinary tree T, every original leaf v with original support s, and every integer p>=3 with |V(T)|<=2p+1, Delta_(p-1)(T-{v,s})-Delta_(p-1)(T-N_T[s])<=0, using integer zero-extended independence counts and original-tree neighborhoods.
claims.scope: Exactly the registered ordinary-leaf order band: finite simple connected acyclic T; original degree-one leaf and support; p>=3; |V(T)|<=2p+1. No favorability, alpha, first-descent, lower-region, or residual premise. The result is an informal proof audit, not a formal award.
claims.reason: The ordered-first-mark partition and adjacent-rank shadow bound prove q_(p)<=q_(p-1) when H has an edge, because component-root coverage supplies a nonisolated marked root and every residual graph has order at most 2(p-1)-1. The edgeless case has W=V(H) and follows from adjacent binomial coefficients; empty H is zero. The report audits the rank shifts, original deletion identities, natural-number domain split, and exact scope.

limitations: Informal proof audit only; no Lean file, build, kernel check, or formal award.
The registered p>=3 and |V(T)|<=2p+1 guards are retained; no broader scope is claimed.
The result does not decide the |V(T)|=2p+2 shell or the unrestricted lower-region favorable-leaf aggregate.
No new computation or public-literature retrieval was used.
